app.description: Application identity. Read only from the package being built.

name.description: Display name on every platform; defaults to the Cargo package name.

identifier.description: Reverse-domain application identifier used by every platform.

icon.description: Square SVG (recommended) or PNG relative to the package root. Outline SVG text and embed external resources; PNG should be at least 1024 x 1024.

dir.description: Asset directory relative to the package root.

embed.description: Glob patterns, relative to dir, of assets embedded in the binary on every target. `*` does not cross directories; use `**` for that.

keep.description: Glob patterns, relative to dir, of platform assets delivered even when no reference to them is found in the binary.

dir.description: Localization catalog directory relative to the package root.

fallback.description: Fallback language and initial entry language, such as en or zh-CN.

plugin.description: Platform modules contributed by a plugin package.

module.description: Gradle module name of the library in the package's android directory.
